capabilities: Log sets with weight and reps
Run rest, interval and hold timers
Append workout summaries and frontmatter stats
disambiguation: Not a launcher or start-page plugin; it is a gym workout logger.
extras: Exercise catalog is bundled for offline use and generated from the MIT-licensed exercises-dataset; the ready-made Workouts.base table needs Obsidian's Bases core plugin enabled.
problem: Logging gym sessions in Obsidian means typing freeform notes with no pre-filled numbers from last time, no personal-record tracking and no rest or hold timers.

relations.evidence: so Obsidian Bases and Dataview can chart and tabulate them across workouts

summary: Mobile-first gym workout logger that records sets, reps and weights into markdown notes, with PR detection, timers and an exercise catalog.
